protocol.instrument: in-process std/time (std.time.nanoTimestamp) around the timed passes; per-iter ns = total_ns / timed_iters; median across process runs
protocol.warmup: 100 untimed passes in-process before the timed block
protocol.note: Baseline numbers in baseline/ are criterion medians — a different instrument on the same machine. Adjacency is not a comparison. simple_iter_1col writes ONE f64 column per row; the reference workload writes a full f32 vec3 position per entity.
